@@ D01 alter schema rename (registered tables' schema)
ALTER SCHEMA aveloxis_data RENAME TO aveloxis_old
@@ D02 other schema renamed TO aveloxis_data
ALTER SCHEMA staging RENAME TO aveloxis_data
@@ D03 truncate other cascade
TRUNCATE aveloxis_data.other CASCADE
@@ D04 drop owned
DROP OWNED BY aveloxis
@@ D05 alter type using
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ALTER COLUMN fe TYPE varchar(3) USING left(fe, 3)
@@ D06 set default
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ALTER COLUMN fe SET DEFAULT 'x'
@@ D07 add generated identity on io
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ALTER COLUMN io ADD GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
@@ D08 rename col into registered
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos RENAME COLUMN zz TO fe
@@ D09 rename col from registered
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos RENAME fe TO zz
@@ D10 drop column cascade
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS fe CASCADE
@@ D11 like + swap
CREATE TABLE aveloxis_data.repos_new (LIKE aveloxis_data.repos INCLUDING ALL)
@;
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos_new RENAME TO repos
@@ D12 drop type cascade
DROP TYPE aveloxis_data.some_enum CASCADE
@@ D13 create or replace view named like registered (unqualified)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW repos AS SELECT 1
@@ D14 create policy
CREATE POLICY p ON aveloxis_data.repos USING (true)
@@ D15 event trigger
CREATE EVENT TRIGGER et ON ddl_command_start EXECUTE FUNCTION f()
@@ D16 trigger on view over registered
CREATE TRIGGER tr INSTEAD OF UPDATE ON aveloxis_data.v_repos FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION f()
@@ D17 alter table rename constraint
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos RENAME CONSTRAINT a TO b
@@ D18 add col with fk action on registered col? (new constraint)
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT fk FOREIGN KEY (fe) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE
@@ D19 add column with fk (column constraint) via ALTER ADD COLUMN named registered
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fe text REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
@@ D20 alter column generic: drop not null
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ALTER COLUMN fe DROP NOT NULL
@@ D21 import foreign schema into aveloxis_data
IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA x FROM SERVER s INTO aveloxis_data
@@ D22 alter view rename to registered
ALTER VIEW aveloxis_data.v_repos RENAME TO repos
@@ D23 subscription
CREATE SUBSCRIPTION s CONNECTION 'x' PUBLICATION p
@@ D24 delete all rows
DELETE FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@@ D25 alter table set schema on other to become child? no: other renamed to registered name in other schema
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_ops.q SET SCHEMA aveloxis_data
@@ D26 alter index rename
ALTER INDEX aveloxis_data.i RENAME TO j
@@ D27 create table ... of type / partition by on new table
CREATE TABLE aveloxis_data.newt (a int) PARTITION BY RANGE (a)
@@ D28 alter table all in tablespace
ALTER TABLE ALL IN TABLESPACE a SET TABLESPACE b
@@ D29 alter sequence owned
ALTER SEQUENCE aveloxis_data.s OWNED BY aveloxis_data.repos.io
@@ D30 alter table alter column type on FK-referenced parent (cascade rewrite?) other
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.other ALTER COLUMN id TYPE bigint
@@ D31 drop schema cascade
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS aveloxis_data CASCADE
@@ D32 alter domain add constraint
ALTER DOMAIN d ADD CONSTRAINT c CHECK (VALUE <> '')
@@ D33 update pg_catalog
UPDATE pg_catalog.pg_attribute SET attname = 'fe' WHERE attname = 'zz'
@@ D34 update pg_class no schema
UPDATE pg_class SET relname = 'x'
@@ D35 alter table ... alter column set data type via ALTER TYPE composite
ALTER TYPE aveloxis_data.comp ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE text CASCADE
@@ D36 alter table rename unqualified
ALTER TABLE repos RENAME TO repos2
@@ D37 alter table repos drop column unqualified
ALTER TABLE repos DROP COLUMN fe
@@ D38 refresh matview
REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW aveloxis_data.m
@@ D39 create table as with same name as registered in other schema then set schema
CREATE TABLE public.repos AS SELECT * FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@@ D40 alter extension / create extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm
